notes: VCA330 (real fix): stop the infinite render loop that froze the invoice View/Update screen (fields unfocusable; 'Maximum update depth exceeded'). InvoiceScreen's print-ready effect depended on an onPrintReady prop passed inline (new fn each render) and called it to setState the parent -> endless re-render whenever a printable invoice was open. Now the callback is read via a ref (effect deps: [canPrintReceipt] only) and the caller memoizes it with useCallback. Supersedes v0.1.197-199 for this bug.
